jobs.title: Technical Writer
jobs.description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:

Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program

What are your contributions to the team?

Write Service Bulletins (SB) that provide clear, concise, and technically accurate instructions for modifications, inspections, or repairs of aircraft. Involving all aircraft systems or any type of component.

This includes:

Researching and reviewing applicable Engineering documentation and other approved technical data from multiple sources.
Writing clearly and concisely structured information within an SB or between multiple SBs.
Preparing lists of parts, wiring processes, materials and tooling required to perform the SB implementation.
Creating or revising part(s) Condition of Supply (COS) documents.
Occasionally support on-site Service Bulletin proof installation/validation (may require travel).
Providing support or information to internal customers (Engineering, Technical Support group) and external customers.
Participating in the SB peer review process.

How to thrive in this role?

Holds a college diploma in Aircraft Maintenance, preferably in Avionics.
Candidates with aviation industry qualifications could also be considered
Possesses prior experience as a technical writer. Expertise in service bulletin (SB) writing is highly desirable.
Demonstrates the ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a hybrid work environment (minimum two days per week in the office).
Exhibits excellent writing and verbal communication skills in English. Strong proficiency in both written and spoken French would also greatly simplify our day-to-day interactions with supporting groups.
Is exceptionally detail-oriented and adapts to managing time-sensitive issues effectively.
Experience with Simplified English is advantageous.
Proficient in reading and interpreting Engineering documents, including wiring diagrams and schematics, drawings, specifications, and maintenance manuals/publications.
Shows strong command of Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with MS Power Tool is an asset.
Strong level of knowledge and experience of SGML/XML authoring tools, such as ArborText Adept Editor, Contenta, or Adobe FrameMaker.

Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

Bombardier is an equal opportunity employer and encourages persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply.
